summary.headline: Sagittarius and Capricorn Prognostications
summary.text: Astrological prognostications for girls born under Sagittarius and Capricorn and a younger man born under Capricorn, describing appearance, character, marriage, wealth, illnesses, dangerous ages, lifespan, and healing through Saints Demetrios, Barbara, and the Holy Unmercenaries.
